emergence.summary: A single-gene HBB loss-of-function -- but a QUANTITATIVE one, the deliberate contrast to sickle cell disease on the SAME HBB locus. HBB encodes the beta-globin chain of adult haemoglobin (HbA = alpha2beta2). Beta-thalassaemia alleles REDUCE (beta+) or ABOLISH (beta0) beta-globin output (promoter/splice/nonsense lesions lowering the amount of an otherwise-normal chain), so beta-globin synthesis falls -> the alpha-globin chains made in excess have no beta partner, precipitate, and damage erythroid precursors -> INEFFECTIVE ERYTHROPOIESIS and haemolysis (transfusion-dependent beta-thalassaemia major; milder beta-thalassaemia intermedia). The beta-globin-output axis is driven DOWN. This is read on the SAME structural-globin axis as sickle cell, but where sickle cell is a QUALITATIVE defect (a single missense, Glu6Val, that makes a normal AMOUNT of an ABNORMAL chain -- HbS -- that polymerises), beta-thalassaemia is a QUANTITATIVE defect (too LITTLE of a normal chain): one gene (HBB), two different KINDS of lesion -- the lesion-TYPE analogue of the Rett <-> MECP2-duplication same-locus pairing (which was a dosage-DIRECTION pair). The kit re-derives the approved corrective arms on the existing engine: (i) POTENTIATE late-stage erythroid maturation -- luspatercept, an activin-receptor-IIB ligand trap that sequesters TGF-beta-superfamily ligands (e.g. GDF11) to relieve SMAD2/3 inhibition of terminal erythroid maturation, raising effective red-cell output despite the beta-globin deficit (the distinctive beta-thalassaemia lead, NOT used in sickle cell); (ii) re-induce FETAL haemoglobin (HbF, alpha2gamma2) to substitute for the missing beta-globin -- oppose BCL11A / exagamglogene autotemcel (the SAME HbF-induction route shared with sickle cell); and (iii) ADD a functional beta-globin gene -- betibeglogene autotemcel (gene addition). The gamma read is of the HBB locus switch STRUCTURE (identical to the sickle-cell read, since it is the same locus); the disease lesions are quantitative (promoter, splice, and nonsense alleles reducing beta-globin amount), outside the promoter-switch firewall as a magnitude question. Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: beta-globin chain output / effective erythropoiesis (HBB structural-globin synthesis; quantitative LOF -> beta-globin deficiency -> excess alpha-chain precipitation -> ineffective erythropoiesis) -- the structural-globin axis, the QUANTITATIVE contrast to sickle cell's QUALITATIVE HBB lesion

per_gene.note: HBB encodes the beta-globin chain of adult haemoglobin (alpha2beta2). Beta-thalassaemia alleles are QUANTITATIVE loss-of-function -- beta+ (reduced) or beta0 (absent) output from promoter, splice-site, or nonsense lesions that lower the AMOUNT of an otherwise-normal beta chain. Reduced beta-globin leaves alpha-globin in excess; unpaired alpha-chains precipitate and kill erythroid precursors -> ineffective erythropoiesis and haemolysis. As a deficient STRUCTURAL globin the beta-output axis goes DOWN. Autosomal recessive, 11p15.4 (OMIM 141900). NCBI official symbol HBB. This is the SAME locus as sickle cell disease, read here for a QUANTITATIVE (amount-reducing) lesion rather than sickle's QUALITATIVE (Glu6Val structural) lesion -- one gene, two lesion types. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the specific quantitative coding/splice/promoter lesions are a magnitude question outside the firewall.

falsifiers.measurable_by: beta-globin chain synthesis and alpha/beta globin-chain ratio in patient erythroid cells vs controls

falsifiers.claim: raising effective erythropoiesis (potentiate maturation / re-induce HbF / add beta-globin) is the CORRECTIVE direction
